terms.name: Claim ID
terms.description: The unique system-generated identifier of a claim (primary key of CLAIM). It is carried as a foreign key in CLAIM_ASSESSMENT, CLAIM_RESERVE and CLAIM_SETTLEMENT and is the join key linking a claim to its assessments, reserves and settlements. Not the same as Claim Number, which is the business identifier.

terms.name: Assessment ID
terms.description: The unique system-generated identifier of an assessment (primary key of CLAIM_ASSESSMENT). It is carried as an optional foreign key in CLAIM_RESERVE to link a reserve to the assessment that justified it. Distinct from the business assessment number.

terms.name: Reserve ID
terms.description: The unique system-generated identifier of a reserve entry (primary key of CLAIM_RESERVE). It is carried as a foreign key in CLAIM_SETTLEMENT to link each settlement to the reserve that funds it. Distinct from the business reserve number.

terms.name: Claim Number
terms.description: The business identifier of a claim, intended to be unique per claim. Expected format CLM-YYYY-NNNNNN (for example CLM-2025-000001).

terms.name: Policy Number
terms.description: The identifier of the insurance policy the claim is made against. Expected format is a product prefix, year and number (for example MOT-2025-883368); the prefix indicates the product line and should agree with the claim type.

terms.name: Claim Type
terms.description: The product line or category of the claim. Values in the sample data: HEALTH_CASHLESS, HEALTH_REIMBURSEMENT, MOTOR_OWN_DAMAGE, MOTOR_THIRD_PARTY, FIRE_PROPERTY, MARINE_CARGO, THEFT, LIABILITY.

terms.name: Claim Status
terms.description: The stage a claim has reached in its lifecycle. Values in the sample data: REGISTERED, UNDER_ASSESSMENT, APPROVED, REJECTED, SETTLED, CLOSED, REOPENED.

terms.name: Loss Date
terms.description: The date the insured event occurred. It should not be later than the reported date and should not be in the future.

terms.name: Reported Date
terms.description: The date the claim was reported to the insurer. It should not be earlier than the loss date.

terms.name: Claim Amount Requested
terms.description: The amount the claimant is asking to be paid.

terms.name: Estimated Loss Amount
terms.description: The insurer's estimate of the total loss, recorded at claim level and at assessment level.

terms.name: Regulatory Reporting Code
terms.description: The code used to classify a claim for regulatory reporting (for example REG-MOT-01). The code should be consistent with the claim type.

terms.name: Fraud Score
terms.description: A numeric indicator of suspected fraud risk, expected on a 0 to 100 scale. Confirm the direction of the scale (higher means higher risk) with the business. Held on both the claim and the assessment.

terms.name: Liability Percentage
terms.description: The share of the loss for which the insurer is liable, from 0 to 100.

terms.name: Damage Estimate
terms.description: The assessor's estimate of the damage or loss found during the assessment.

terms.name: Assessment Status
terms.description: The progress of an assessment. Values in the sample data: PENDING, COMPLETED, REVISED.

terms.name: Assessment Completed Flag
terms.description: A Y/N indicator that the assessment is finished. It should agree with the assessment status.

terms.name: Reserve Amount
terms.description: The monetary value of a reserve, in the currency given by the currency code.

terms.name: Currency Code
terms.description: The ISO 4217 three-letter code of the currency of an amount. The default in the model is INR.

terms.name: Reserve Status
terms.description: The state of a reserve. Values in the sample data: ACTIVE, ADJUSTED, RELEASED.

terms.name: Approved Settlement Amount
terms.description: The amount approved for payment on a settlement.

terms.name: Final Settlement Amount
terms.description: The amount finally settled after any adjustments. It should not exceed the approved settlement amount.

terms.name: Payment Status
terms.description: The state of a payment. Values in the sample data: INITIATED, PAID, FAILED, REVERSED.

terms.name: Payment Date
terms.description: The date the payment was made. It should not be earlier than the settlement date and should be empty until the payment is made.

terms.name: Payment Reference
terms.description: The transaction reference that identifies a payment (for example NEFT20250420641375: method, date and number). It is expected once a payment is made and should be unique per payment.

terms.name: Reserve Effective From
terms.description: The date on which the reserve becomes effective and starts applying.

terms.name: Reserve Effective To
terms.description: The date on which the reserve's effective period ends. This may remain blank while the reserve is active.

terms.name: Claim Last Updated Timestamp
terms.description: The date and time when a claim record was last updated in the source system. This timestamp supports monitoring the freshness of claim data and identifying records that may not have been updated recently.

cdes.name: Claim ID
cdes.description: Unique system-generated identifier of a claim. It is the primary key of CLAIM and the foreign key in CLAIM_ASSESSMENT, CLAIM_RESERVE and CLAIM_SETTLEMENT. Critical because it is the join key for the whole model, and orphaned values break the link between a claim and its assessments, reserves and settlements.

cdes.name: Assessment ID
cdes.description: Unique system-generated identifier of an assessment. It is the primary key of CLAIM_ASSESSMENT and the optional foreign key in CLAIM_RESERVE. Critical because orphaned values break the link between a reserve and the assessment that justified it.

cdes.name: Reserve ID
cdes.description: Unique system-generated identifier of a reserve entry. It is the primary key of CLAIM_RESERVE and the foreign key in CLAIM_SETTLEMENT. Critical because orphaned values leave a settlement with no funding reserve.

cdes.name: Claim Number
cdes.description: Business identifier of the claim. Critical because duplicates cause double handling and double payment.

cdes.name: Policy Number
cdes.description: Identifier of the policy the claim is made against. Critical because a wrong value means paying against the wrong coverage.

cdes.name: Claim Type
cdes.description: Product line or category of the claim. Critical because it drives reserving approach and the regulatory code.

cdes.name: Claim Status
cdes.description: Stage of the claim in its lifecycle. Critical because it drives lifecycle reporting, reserving and settlement eligibility.

cdes.name: Loss Date
cdes.description: Date the insured event occurred. Critical for coverage validity and late-reporting checks.

cdes.name: Reported Date
cdes.description: Date the claim was reported to the insurer. Critical for turnaround and SLA measurement.

cdes.name: Claim Amount Requested
cdes.description: Amount the claimant is asking to be paid. Core financial exposure figure.

cdes.name: Estimated Loss Amount
cdes.description: The insurer's estimate of the total loss, recorded at claim level (CLAIM) and assessment level (CLAIM_ASSESSMENT). Core financial exposure figure; the two values should be governed consistently.

cdes.name: Regulatory Reporting Code
cdes.description: Code that classifies the claim for regulatory reporting. Critical because it determines how the claim appears in regulatory reports.

cdes.name: Fraud Score
cdes.description: Numeric fraud-risk indicator, expected on a 0 to 100 scale, held on both CLAIM and CLAIM_ASSESSMENT. Critical because it feeds fraud-review decisions; the two values should be governed consistently.

cdes.name: Liability Percentage
cdes.description: Share of the loss for which the insurer is liable, from 0 to 100. Main input to how much is paid.

cdes.name: Damage Estimate
cdes.description: Assessor's estimate of the damage or loss found. Main input to reserving and settlement amounts.

cdes.name: Assessment Status
cdes.description: Progress of the assessment. Acts as a control gate before reserving and settlement and must agree with the completed flag.

cdes.name: Assessment Completed Flag
cdes.description: Y/N indicator that the assessment is finished (stored as a single character). Control gate that must agree with the assessment status.

cdes.name: Reserve Amount
cdes.description: Monetary value set aside for the claim. The most financially significant column; it feeds financial reporting.

cdes.name: Currency Code
cdes.description: ISO 4217 currency of the amount (default INR). Without it the reserve amount cannot be interpreted.

cdes.name: Reserve Status
cdes.description: State of the reserve (active, adjusted, released). Defines which reserve is in force; errors cause stale or overlapping reserves.

cdes.name: Reserve Effective From
cdes.description: Start date of the reserve's effective period. Defines which reserve is in force.

cdes.name: Approved Settlement Amount
cdes.description: Amount approved for payment on a settlement. Money actually paid out.

cdes.name: Final Settlement Amount
cdes.description: Amount finally settled after adjustments; should not exceed the approved amount. Money actually paid out.

cdes.name: Payment Status
cdes.description: State of the payment (initiated, paid, failed, reversed). Shows whether cash has moved.

cdes.name: Payment Date
cdes.description: Date the payment was made. Shows when cash moved; must not precede the settlement date.

cdes.name: Payment Reference
cdes.description: Transaction reference identifying the payment. Lets you trace payments and detect double payments.

cdes.name: Reserve Effective To
cdes.description: End date of the reserve's effective period. Empty while the reserve is active; must not precede the start date.

cdes.name: Claim Last Updated Timestamp
cdes.description: The date and time when the claim record was last updated in the source system.

dataAssets.name: CLAIM
dataAssets.description: Master record for each insurance claim, one row per claim. It holds the policy and claimant, claim type and status, loss and reported dates, requested and estimated loss amounts, deductible, fraud score, SLA breach flag and regulatory reporting code. It's the parent table: assessments, reserves and settlements all link to it through CLAIM_ID. CLAIM_NUMBER is the business identifier.

dataAssets.name: CLAIM_ASSESSMENT
dataAssets.description: Assessments, surveys and reviews carried out on a claim, one row per assessment. It records the assessor, assessment date, type and status, damage estimate, estimated loss, liability percentage, fraud score and a completion flag, plus free-text remarks. A claim can have many assessments (CLAIM_ID), and an assessment can inform one or more reserves.

dataAssets.name: CLAIM_RESERVE
dataAssets.description: Financial reserves set aside for a claim, one row per reserve entry. It records the type (such as indemnity or expense), amount, currency (default INR), status, reason code and the period it is effective (EFFECTIVE_FROM to EFFECTIVE_TO). A reserve belongs to a claim and can optionally link to the assessment that justified it (ASSESSMENT_ID, nullable). It funds the settlements made against it.
